channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Delhi’s air quality shows marginal improvement with strong winds; AQI ‘very poor’
item.description: Delhi experienced a slight improvement in air quality on Wednesday, aided by relatively strong surface winds, though pollution levels continued to remain in the ‘very poor’ category.

item.title: Voting underway for third phase of panchayat elections in Telangana
item.description: Polling was underway for the third and final phase of Gram Panchayat elections in Telangana on Wednesday. Elections were being held for 3,752 Sarpanch posts and 28,410 Ward Members in 182 mandals across 31 districts.

item.title: Indian Railways using 898 MW solar power at 2,626 stations: Govt
item.description: Indian Railways has achieved a major milestone in clean energy use and by November this year, it has commissioned 898 MW of solar power for its operations.

item.title: Vivek Oberoi claims to be dad Suresh Oberoi’s ‘shadow’ in a heartfelt birthday message
item.description: Actor Vivek Oberoi claimed to be his father Suresh Oberoi's 'shadow' in a heartfelt birthday post. The 'Mast' actor revealed that while he was never intimidated by Bollywood, his biggest concern was to live up to the phenomenal legacy left by his father, whose style and charisma are unlike any other.

item.title: India launches AI-driven community screening for diabetic retinopathy
item.description: In a bid to curb the rising vision loss cases due to diabetes, India has launched the first Artificial Intelligence (AI)-driven community screening programme for Diabetic Retinopathy (DR).

item.title: SC Collegium recommends elevation of two judicial officers as Punjab and Haryana HC judges
item.description: The Supreme Court Collegium, headed by Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant, has recommended the appointment of two judicial officers as judges of the Punjab and Haryana High Court.

item.title: PM Modi invites Ethiopian counterpart Abiy Ahmed Ali to AI Impact Summit, BRICS meet in India
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has invited his Ethiopian counterpart, Abiy Ahmed Ali, to attend the AI Impact Summit and the BRICS Summit, both scheduled to be hosted by India in 2026, the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) said on Wednesday.

item.title: Luthra brothers brought to Goa a day after deportation from Thailand
item.description: Saurabh and Gaurav Luthra, owners of the North Goa nightclub 'Birch by Romeo Lane,' were brought back to Goa on Wednesday by the police, a day after they were deported from Thailand.

item.title: Karnataka BJP warns of protest over Gruha Laxmi dues issue; seeks apology from minister
item.description: He alleged that Women and Child Welfare Minister Laxmi Hebbalkar misled the Assembly by providing false information.

item.title: Genelia Deshmukh wishes ‘heartbeat’ Riteish on 47th b’day: Will celebrate you everyday
item.description: Actress Genelia Deshmukh penned an emotional note for husband Riteish Deshmukh as he turned 47 on Wednesday, calling him her “heartbeat” and the reason behind their “inseparable bond”.
